This game is a blast.

I played EDF 4.1, beginning to end, through the DLC packs with the same group of friends. We've been salivating at the chance to play EDF 5 when it would finally hit the PC. Now we play this game together when our schedules line up.

The worst I can say about EDF 5 is "It's more of the same". To me, that's a great thing. If it's not broke, don't fix it. Inversely, if it's broke, fix it. And that's the best thing I can say about EDF 5. There are so many small improvements they've made to the various game-play elements that improve the entire experience. Way too many to list. This is exactly what I want to see from a 9/10ths sequel. 

My recommendation is thus: Buy EDF 5 on sale if you don't have friends you can 100% confirm to play the game with. Buy the game as soon as possible if you do have friends who'll play it with you. Hell, I've had so much fun with this series that I've bought extra copies for friends, all at full price. Once the game is bought, go into the reviews and share your experience.

A true video game at its most basic and simplest form: Pure Chaotic Fun.

This is not a game that set out to break graphical barriers, ground-breaking mechanics or an emotional story (although the story is still great). This game is simple: Make sure your side wins by being the last one standing.

Earth has been invaded by your typical B-Movie style aliens that want to conquer the world for reasons unknown. They set out to accomplish this task by unleashing hordes of giant alien insects and robots. Each mission plays out relatively the same: kill anything non-human and the mission is considered a success. 

Most areas of battle are large open areas located in a massive, non-descript city. All building can be destroyed, but you are not rated, nor impacted negatively, by collateral damage; you're called the Earth Defense Force, not the City Defense Force.

You can choose between Four classes that offer distinct playstyles:
Ranger - The easiest class with the most versitility.
Wing Diver - Lightly armored with high maneuverability with flight capabilities
Air Raider - Support class capable of launching Air Strikes.
Fencer - Heavy infantry with heavy armor and carries the biggest guns.

The real charm of this game is in its game play loop: complete mission while gaining armor and weapon drops to grow your character in strength. There are five difficulty levels that can be switched between at any time and the harder ones give better weapons. There are hundreds of weapons to collect throughout all five difficulties and all four classes.
All story takes place in the background and is not vital for enjoyment, however, the campy dialogue provides countless chuckles.

If you just want a simple yet highly addictive game; EDF 5 is a must play.

Absolutely fun to play co-op (4 player btw)...and you can annoy them with singing heh heh heh.  But not sure about the price atm - 50e here.  Get it when it's on discount, it is definitely worth 20-30e with friends - less is always better. Otherwise a bloomin' good game.
Magnificent game, a worthy sequel to EDF 4.1
